definition: The Male-Specific Lethal 2 Homolog (MSL2) gene encodes a core component of the male-specific lethal chromatin-modifying complex; pathogenic variants in MSL2 cause Karayol-Borroto-Haghshenas neurodevelopmental syndrome (OMIM #620985), a rare condition characterized by neurodevelopmental delay, brain abnormalities such as ventriculomegaly, motor and coordination difficulties, and variable dysmorphic features.

source.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of MSL2‐Related Ventriculomegaly in Association With an Inherited 15q13 Microduplication
source.quote: The Male-Specific Lethal 2 Homolog (MSL2) gene was recently reported to be responsible for a novel, rather severe neurodevelopmental syndrome including brain abnormalities.
